title: Vibrant Crunchy Greek Lamb Kidney Skewers
description: A light and refreshing Greek dish featuring lamb kidney, wood-fired baked to perfection, with a vegan-friendly alternative, this recipe combines sour and crunchy elements for a unique taste experience.

ingredients.name: lamb kidney
ingredients.notes: or portobello mushrooms for vegan alternative

instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, and thyme.
Add the lamb kidney or portobello mushrooms to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated lamb kidney or mushrooms onto skewers.
Place the skewers in the wood-fired oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the pita bread into thin strips and toast until crispy.
Slice the tomatoes and red onion into thin wedges.
To serve, place the skewers on a platter and top with toasted pita bread, tomatoes, and red onion.
Drizzle with additional lemon juice and olive oil if desired.
